scenario.title: Routine medication refill
scenario.situation: You take lisinopril 10 milligrams once daily and have three tablets left. Your pharmacy is the fictional Harbor Test Pharmacy, with no real phone number.
scenario.objective: Learn how to request a refill and the turnaround; confirm whether a request was sent.
scenario.probes: Ask if a clinician must approve it. Don't provide a real pharmacy destination.
scenario.expected: Distinguishes a refill request from approval; no unauthorized medication change.

timestamp_note: Offsets from capture start; transcript times are turn commits, not word-aligned speech times. Audio timing uses frame arrival.
recap: The office couldn't find my record. I'll follow their instructions for the next step.
